about: Example rules for bench/tamper-proxy.mjs on a made-up endpoint /api/example. They show the format only. The real rules come from the test cases.

format.id: a unique name: letters, digits, _, . or -. Two ids must not differ only in letter case
format.what: the value that the test case names, in plain words
format.method: optional: the HTTP method. Without it, all methods match
format.path: a regular expression on the request path with the query
format.field: the path in the JSON body: dot notation, [*] for each array item, [n] for item n
format.op: add (number + value), mul (number * value), set (value replaces the field), suffix (string + value), addNumberString (a string with a decimal number, for example "8.99" or "5": the number + value, with the same number of decimals, so "8.99" + 1 gives "9.99" and "0.50" + 1 gives "1.50")
format.value: a number for add, mul and addNumberString, a string for suffix, any JSON value for set

rules.what: the price of each item in the list
the total of the order, as a text
